messages.content: 轉換句子「Hello, how are you?」從英文到法文。

function.name: compress_file
function.description: Compresses a given file into a zip archive. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

file_path.description: The path of the file to compress.

archive_name.description: The name of the resulting archive.

compression_level.description: The level of compression to apply (from 0 to 9). Default is 5.

message.reasoning: The user wants to translate the sentence "Hello, how are you?" from English to French. They want the translation. So we just provide the French translation: "Bonjour, comment ça va ?" or "Bonjour, comment allez-vous ?" The more formal: "Bonjour, comment allez-vous ?" The casual: "Bonjour, comment ça va ?" The user didn't specify formality. We can give both. But likely they want a direct translation: "Bonjour, comment vas-tu ?" But "how are you?" is "comment vas-tu?" for informal. For formal: "comment allez-vous?" So we can provide the translation. Probably just one. I'll give "Bonjour, comment vas-tu ?" or "Bonjour, comment allez-vous ?" I'll choose "Bonjour, comment vas-tu ?" as it's common. Or maybe "Bonjour, comment allez-vous ?" It's safer to give both. But the user asked "轉換句子" meaning "convert the sentence". So just give the translation. I'll give "Bonjour, comment vas-tu ?"
